items.conclusion: Within the supplied harmonic periodic-cell boundary, the evidence supports broken nominal monoclinic symmetry and substantial water participation in the hydrated-V2O5 Raman features, especially near 890 cm⁻¹; finite-temperature disorder remains unresolved.
